flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:9090/login/ then Log in with username {{global.ld_user}} and password {{secrets.user.ld_pass}}.
In the top navigation bar, open the 'Settings' dropdown menu.
Verify the dropdown contains an item labelled 'Admin'.
Click 'Admin'.
Verify a page titled 'Site administration' (the linkding administration page) is shown.
